scope: Round 4 integration on branch m4: open-loop replays of logged flights and the measured surrogate; development evidence, never flight evidence. Nothing here was flown.

stacks.base: m2-vertical 935cfdb stack on: gap pilot v2, wall pilot v3, vertical guard v2, lag turn v2 (round-4 vertical-guard baseline replays, tree identical to git archive m2-vertical)

surrogate.note:
Score the integration surrogate runs with the descent-view gates' own metric definitions and thresholds
(haltere.liftoff.descent_gates.score_controller; configs/pilot/descent_view_gates.json v1, frozen), for pairs of
variants: dv, stack and full against baseline, and full against stack. Only the pd/brain08/brain09b dv-vs-baseline
pairs are the frozen gates' own scoring; everything else applies the same definitions as a report (the gates name no
brain-10 controller and no stacked variant). Development evidence only.
